en: Colorized vintage harbor view showing a busy port with multiple large passenger and cargo ships moored along quays, smaller boats moving in the foreground, and an old-looking tugboat prominently in front. The shoreline behind is built up with brick warehouses and mid‑rise buildings, plus cranes and masts. On a hill to the right stands a tall church‑like stone tower with a steep roof, dominating the skyline. The image has a decorative, slightly scalloped border typical of old postcards.
